text:
maria: Heads up — noticed a spike in invoices with split line items for the 2026-03-01 billing window. Looks like Stripe webhooks retried and our NetSuite backfill created partial duplicates. Anyone else seeing this?
aj: Yep, I flagged ~14 invoices from last night's backfill run. Getting 409s on a few NetSuite PATCH calls, so we retried and might've done partial writes.
sam_ops: deploy-bot: backfill-processor v1.8.3 deployed at 2026-03-22T18:40 — rolling.
leo_engineer: Can you drop one example invoice id and the Stripe event id so I can trace?
maria: invoice_2026-03-01-009, stripe_event ev_1JqX... (redacted). Screenshot and sample payload uploaded to the finance drive.
leo_engineer: Looking at the payload — older Stripe events don't include our idempotency token. Our backfill dedupe uses event.id, but the live NetSuite sync uses charge.id as the unique key. That mismatch allows a webhook retry + backfill overlap to create split prorations.
nina_accounting: Outcome is messy line splitting on some customers (two small prorated lines instead of single aggregated). It's low $ but high noise for accountants. Do we need manual credits?
aj: I have a patch that changes dedupe to use (stripe.event.id + stripe.charge.id) as the composite key. Running tests now. If green I'll push a canary to staging.
maria: Please hold the nightly backfill until we validate the canary — we can't risk more splits overnight.
sam_ops: Paused cron job nightly-backfill at 2026-03-22T20:05 — CSP job set to hold. Noted: manual resume after sign-off.
leo_engineer: For mitigation I ran a one-off idempotent reconciliation that groups sibling lines by merchant_reference + amount within a 1hr window and merges where safe. Generates audit CSV we can review. Command: `./recon/merge --window 1h --preview`
aj: Ran the merge in preview then live on the 30 affected invoices found — merged 27 automatically. Output CSV: /internal/recon/merge-1745006789.csv (internal path).
nina_accounting: I'll review the CSV and approve credits for the 3 cases that couldn't auto-merge. Please include reasoning column for manual adjustments.
maria: TL;DR: root cause = webhook retry + mismatched dedupe keys between backfill and live sync. Action items: hold backfill, deploy dedupe patch + canary, run reconciliation, accounting to approve credits. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
leo_engineer: I'll open a follow-up PR to add an integration test covering backfill vs live webhook overlap and a small DB migration note.
aj: Canary scheduled in staging for 2026-03-23T02:00 UTC. Will post results in this thread.
sam_ops: Noted. If anyone sees a new split after canary, ping me and I'll temporarily block the queue.
maria: Appreciate the quick turnaround — let's sync tomorrow 10am finance/dev standup if needed.
